resources.string: Read these terms before using Zairenkai. Tap any section to read it in full.
I have read and agree to the Zairenkai Terms of Use, risk disclaimer and Privacy Policy.

Zairenkai is a performance manager for rooted Android devices. It reads the state of the system and, only when you ask it to, applies profiles and tweaks through the zperfd engine on top of the ZKFC kernel framework.

By using Zairenkai you agree to: use it only on devices you own or are authorised to modify; not use it to break the law or the rights of others; and not reverse engineer, modify or redistribute the app except as its licence allows.

These terms may be updated. When they change, the new version is shown and asks for your consent again.
Root and kernel tuning carry risk

Root access and changes to kernel parameters (CPU and GPU frequencies, the scheduler, memory) can affect your device's stability, temperature, battery life and warranty.

Zairenkai keeps the existing safeguards: every change is applied through zperfd, read back from the kernel and rolled back if it fails; its limits follow the kernel thermal guard and SAFE MODE after a failed boot. The app does not disable the manufacturer's thermal daemon.

Even so, this software is provided "as is", without warranty of any kind. To the extent permitted by law, the developer is not liable for damage, data loss or other harm resulting from its use.

Zairenkai does not request internet access and sends no data off your device. There are no accounts, ads, analytics or tracking.

Data the app creates (settings, usage and power history, FPS sessions) is stored locally in the app's private storage, is not backed up to the cloud, and is deleted when the app is uninstalled.

Usage access and notifications are used only for the features described in the permissions step. A diagnostics report is copied to the clipboard only when you tap Copy, and never contains token contents or keys.
Proprietary software and the API token

Zairenkai is proprietary software, © 2026 FebriCahyaa (LicenseRef-Zairenkai-Proprietary). This licence gives you the right to use the app, not ownership of its code, design or mascot artwork.\n\nPerformance features are unlocked with an API token bound to your device and verified by the kernel. Do not share your token; shared tokens can be revoked.

Zairenkai is built with open-source components, including AndroidX and Jetpack Compose, Kotlin and kotlinx, and Lottie, mostly under the Apache License 2.0, and the Google Sans Flex font under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.\n\nThe full list (name, version, developers, website and the complete licence text of every component) is in Open-source licences.
